derivation: from H2225 (זֶרַח) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has risen;
def: Zerachjah, the name of two Israelites

occurrences.text: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,
Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
The son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,
Of the sons of Pahath–moab; Elihoenai the son of Zerahiah, and with him two hundred males.
